title: orz-site.json (config format 1)
description: The config of an orz-site static site (orz-site spec/site.md §3, family contract FC-20). Unknown keys are errors. The config format version is independent of the orz-site package version.

format.description: The config format version. A newer format is refused (newer-config).

carriers.description: The exact shell version per kind (an npm version of orz-mdhtml / orz-slides / orz-paged). A kind the site does not use may be omitted; `orz-site check` requires a pin for every kind used.

delivery.description: Delivery of every page's engine: cdn (from jsDelivr; the right choice for sites, FD-07) or inline (embedded).

inline.description: Documents assembled inline anyway (e.g. a handout meant to be downloaded and used offline).

naming.description: Output names. "family" = FC-18's twins (x.md → x.md.html, x.slides.md → x.slides.html, x.paged.md → x.paged.html). Per-kind templates ({ "md": "{stem}.html" }) are valid here but refused by orz-site 0.1 (naming-needs-kit): they need the kit's twinLinks option (K1).

baseUrl.description: The site's absolute URL, ending in /. `orz-site build --base-url` overrides it (route A passes the Pages URL). Needed for the sitemap and own-host includes.

allowedHosts.description: Hosts whose https URLs may be included (fetched once per build; SHA-256 in the manifest). The site's own host is read from the site's files, never the network.

network.description: false: fetch nothing (like --offline); a URL include on another host is then include-network.

missing.description: A missing or refused include: error (default) or warn (the page shows the kit's 'Included file not available' note).
A link to a text that is not built (missing, excluded, empty, outside the root).

exclude.description: Paths neither built nor published (still readable as file include sources). Always excluded besides: dot paths, node_modules/, names ending in ~, orz-site.json, the output folder.

texts.description: Also publish each document's text twin as is (x.slides.md next to x.slides.html).

index.description: The generated index: an orz md document assembled by the pinned orz-mdhtml.

mode.description: auto: write index.html when no page or asset is index.html; on: always (a clash is name-collision); off: never.

theme.description: A theme id of orz-mdhtml, or null for its default.

notFound.description: A text at the site root whose page is written as 404.html instead of its own name.

template.description: A file-name template: {stem} once, otherwise A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -, ending in .html, no /.

globs.description: Globs on site paths: * (not /), ** (any depth), ?; a pattern ending in / is the folder and everything under it. No negation, braces or classes.
